name: valve_ep2_cannon
note: EP2's three-way Combine autogun (ep2_outland_09): three func_tank_combine_cannon guns on one stand, each aimed by an npc_enemyfinder_combinecannon, mounted outside the south wall of a garage's turret bay, with its power generator inside; a grenade in the generator's open intake blows it up, the cannon dies and the wall behind the generator is blown out

solids.from: func_breakable (taken shut, as a static slab)

extras.what: Not placed by place(): what in Valve's map steers the cannon from outside the bay, kept for a builder to copy by hand. The two areaportal windows (portal.cannon, apwindow.cannon: the breakable's outputs widen portal.cannon's fade when the wall is blown) and the AI node link link.cannon (turned on with the power, so NPCs path through the blown wall) need our own map's areas and nodes. Valve's show: ai_relationship pairs that make the cannon shoot one target on cue (rank 9999 or 99 over its other hates, applied by a trigger or a template's OnEntitySpawned) at npc_bullseyes on a crate, a van, a burning headcrab and a zombie torso, and the triggers that cue them. The harass zones: trigger_multiples that send cannon_* EnableHarrass or DisableHarrass as the player walks in and out of cover. Their other outputs are Valve's story.
